! Game text
| If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a Jedi here. '''Luminous Beings''': Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile. || If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects.
